Is World of Warships: Legends AI generated?

Wargaming Group LimitedMay 4, 2026Steam page ↗

Generative AI was used in development for unit testing and some art elements, reviewed by the team; final core assets are human-made.

The disclosure hedges how much was made with AI ("some", "certain assets").

What the developer wrote

Generative AI is used solely during development for supplemental, non-essential purposes, including unit testing or the creation of certain art elements. These AI-generated outputs are limited in scope, reviewed by our development team, and never substituted human creative or technical decision-making. All final core assets and game content are created entirely by Wargaming’s artists and developers.

Steam "AI Generated Content Disclosure" · first seen Oct 26, 2026 · last checked Nov 1, 2026
